theme: alchemist pans a river for seven powders
title: River Alchemist: The Settling Cascade
strategies: single mega-basin: one basin sized to isolate only the easiest (smallest-threshold) powder, ignore the rest (baseline)
per-class id-order sizing: build one basin per powder in input order, each sized only for its own threshold with a fixed depth, ignoring both cascade order and scour safety
threshold-sorted cut sequence: order basins by ascending settling threshold so each basin resolves exactly one class boundary, with depth chosen for scour safety at no extra volume cost
randomized local search over basin count/order/depth-length splits seeded from the instance
